options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the list (aria-label on the <ul>). Must be non-empty after trimming.

options.name: items
options.type: readonly { id: string; label: string; content?: Node | string; disabled?: boolean }[]
options.description: Items in order. Ids must be unique, non-empty, and stable; labels non-empty (used in the handle name and announcements). Rows are kept by id on update; the array order defines the DOM order.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable reordering for the whole list (all handles disabled).

options.name: dragFrom
options.description: Where a pointer drag can start: the handle only, or anywhere on a movable item (interactive content inside the item keeps its own pointer behavior).

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: order
properties.description: Item ids in the current DOM order.

properties.name: isDragging
properties.description: Whether an item is grabbed (keyboard) or dragged (pointer).

properties.name: options
properties.description: Current instance options (items keep the last order passed in, not the DOM order).

methods.name: move
methods.description: Move an item to a zero-based index; cancels an active grab or drag first. No event, no announcement. Throws SORTABLE_LIST_OPTIONS for an unknown id or an index outside 0..count-1.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and apply options; cancels an active grab or drag. Rows and content nodes are kept by id; content is re-inserted only when it changed.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cancel any grab or drag, remove rendering, listeners, drag tracking, and subscriptions, and clear the host's children and classes.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { order: string[]; id: string; from: number; to: number }
events.description: Dispatched on the host after a keyboard or pointer drop that changed the item's position. from and to are zero-based. Not emitted for cancels, drops in place, move(), or update().

contentAreas.name: item content
contentAreas.description: Each item's `content` (Node or text) or, without it, its label text, inside .aui-sortable-list__content.

cssClasses.name: aui-sortable-list--disabled
cssClasses.description: Host modifier: the whole list is disabled.

cssClasses.name: aui-sortable-list__item
cssClasses.description: One <li> per item; data-id holds the item id.

cssClasses.name: aui-sortable-list__item--dragging
cssClasses.description: The item is following the pointer (translateY by --aui-sortable-list-offset).

cssClasses.name: aui-sortable-list__instructions
cssClasses.description: Visually hidden instructions referenced by every handle's aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: --aui-sortable-list-offset
cssClasses.description: Custom property set through the CSSOM during a pointer drag: vertical offset in px.
